name: beekey-medics
description: Beekey Medics web app — medicines, online doctor consults and lab tests from a local partner network.

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && echo 'JS OK'
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run cap:sync && bash scripts/emulator.sh && npx cap run android --target $(adb devices | awk '/^emulator-/{print $1; exit}' || echo emulator-5554)
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
